input: TS 24.501 - 5.4.4.3 - Generic UE configuration update accepted by the UE: If acknowledgement requested is indicated in the Acknowledgement bit of the Configuration update indication IE in the CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message, the UE shall send a CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE message.

TS 24.501 - 5.4.4.3 - Generic UE configuration update accepted by the UE: Upon receiving the CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message, the UE shall stop timer T3346 if running and use the contents to update appropriate information stored within the UE.

TS 24.501 - 4.4.3.2 Replay protection: Replay protection shall be supported for received NAS messages both in the AMF and the UE. However, since the realization of replay protection does not affect the interoperability between nodes, no specific mechanism is required for implementation.

TS 24.501 - 4.4.3.1 - General: If the receiver can guarantee that this NAS message was not previously accepted, then the receiver may select the estimated NAS overflow counter so that the estimated NAS COUNT value is lower than the stored NAS COUNT value; otherwise, the receiver selects the estimated NAS overflow counter so that the estimated NAS COUNT value is higher than the stored NAS COUNT value.

TS 24.501 - 5.4.2.3 - NAS security mode command accepted by the UE: The UE shall in addition reset the uplink NAS COUNT counter if: a) the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message is received in order to take a 5G NAS security context into use created after a successful execution of the 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure or the EAP based primary authentication and key agreement procedure; or b) the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message received includes the type of security context flag set to mapped security context in the NAS key set identifier IE the ngKSI does not match the current 5G NAS security context, if it is a mapped 5G NAS security context.

TS 24.501 - 9.1.1 - NAS message format: If the message is a security protected 5GS NAS message: a) extended protocol discriminator; b) security header type associated with a half spare octet; c) message authentication code; d) sequence number; e) plain 5GS NAS message, as defined in item 1.
TS 24.501 - 4.4.4.1 - General: For the UE, integrity protected signalling is mandatory for the 5GMM NAS messages once a valid 5G NAS security context exists and has been taken into use

TS 24.501 - 4.4.4.3 - Integrity checking of NAS signalling messages in the AMF: Except the messages listed below, no NAS signalling messages shall be processed by the receiving 5GMM entity in the AMF or forwarded to the 5GSM entity, unless the secure exchange of NAS messages has been established for the NAS signalling connection: a) REGISTRATION REQUEST; b) IDENTITY RESPONSE (if requested identification parameter is SUCI); c) AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE; d) AUTHENTICATION FAILURE; e) SECURITY MODE REJECT; f) DEREGISTRATION REQUEST; and g) DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT.

TS 24.501 - 5.5.2.2.2 - UE-initiated de-registration procedure completion: When the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message is received by the AMF, the AMF shall send a DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT message to the UE.
TS 24.501 - 4.4.6 - Protection of initial NAS signalling messages: When the initial NAS message is a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message, the UE always sends the NAS message unciphered.
TS 24.501 - 4.4.3.1 - General - The NAS COUNT counters use 24-bit internal representation and are independently maintained by UE and AMF.

TS 24.501 - 5.4.3.3 - Identification response by the UE: A UE shall be ready to respond to an IDENTITY REQUEST message at any time whilst in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode. 1. if timer T3519 is not running, generate a fresh SUCI as specified in 3GPP TS 33.501, send an IDENTITY RESPONSE message with the SUCI, start timer T3519 and store the value of the SUCI sent in the IDENTITY RESPONSE message;

TS24.501 - 5.4.3.1 - General: The purpose of this procedure is to request a particular UE to provide specific identification parameters, e.g. the SUCI, the IMEI, the IMEISV, the EUI-64 or the MAC address.
TS 24.501 - 5.4.3.3 - Identification response by the UE: A UE shall be ready to respond to an IDENTITY REQUEST message at any time whilst in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode.

TS 24.501 - 5.4.3.3 - Identification response by the UE: if the Identity type IE in the IDENTITY REQUEST message is not set to "SUCI", the UE shall send an IDENTITY RESPONSE message to the network. The IDENTITY RESPONSE message shall contain the identification parameters as requested by the network;

TS 24.501 - 5.4.3.3 - Identification response by the UE: if the Identity type IE in the IDENTITY REQUEST message is set to "SUCI"  the UE shall: 1) if timer T3519 is not running, generate a fresh SUCI as specified in 3GPP TS 33.501 [24], send an IDENTITY RESPONSE message with the SUCI, start timer T3519 and store the value of the SUCI sent in the IDENTITY RESPONSE message; and 2) if timer T3519 is running, send an IDENTITY RESPONSE message with the stored SUCI.

TS 24.501 - 5.4.1.3.6 - Authentication not accepted by the UE: The UE may reject the core network due to an incorrect AUTN or ngKSI parameter. If the UE has to reject the 5G authentication challenge, the UE shall return AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message to the network with a cause value indicating the reason for the failure.

TS 24.501 - 5.5.1.3.5 - Mobility and periodic registration update not accepted by the network: the AMF shall send REGISTRATION REJECT message including 5GMM cause #9 'UE identity cannot be derived by the network'.

TS 24.501 - 5.5.1.2.5 - Initial registration not accepted by the network: If 5GMM cause #76 is received from: 1. a CAG cell, and if the UE receives a 'CAG information list' in the CAG information list IE included in the REGISTRATION REJECT message, the UE shall delete any stored 'CAG information list' and shall store the received 'CAG information list'. Otherwise, then the UE shall delete the CAG-ID(s) of the cell from the 'allowed CAG list' for the current PLMN.

TS 24.501 - 5.5.1.2.5 - Initial registration not accepted by the network: If the REGISTRATION REJECT message is not integrity protected, the UE shall start timer T3346 with a random value from the default range specified in 3GPP TS 24.008.
TS 24.501 - 8.2.18 - Service rejectThe SERVICE REJECT message is sent by the AMF to the UE in order to reject the service request procedure.

TS 24.501 - 5.5.2.1 - General: When upper layers indicate that emergency services are no longer required, the UE if still registered for emergency services, may perform UE-initiated de-registration procedure followed by a re-registration to regain normal services, if the UE is in or moves to a suitable cell

TS 24.501 - 4.5.2 - Determination of the access identities and access category associated with a request for access for UEs not operating in SNPN access mode: NOTE5: The UE configured for NAS signalling low priority is not supported in this release of specification.
TS 38.331 - 4.2.1 - UE states and state transitions including inter RAT: Acquires system information, while SDT procedure is not ongoing, and can send SI request (if configured);

TS 24.501 - 5.3.1.4 - 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication: If the UE in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication receives an indication from the lower layers about RAN paging and the MUSIM UE decides to reject the RAN paging, the UE shall initiate the service request procedure and set request type to "NAS signalling connection release" in the UE request type IE and service type to "signalling" in the SERVICE REQUEST message as specified in subclause5.6.1.2 for case o of subclause5.6.1.1. The UE may include its paging restriction preferences in the Paging restriction IE in the SERVICE REQUEST message as specified in subclause5.6.1.2 for case o of subclause5.6.1.1
TS 24.501 - 5.6.1.1 - General: the UE in 5GMM-IDLE mode over 3GPP access has to request resources for V2X communication over PC5 (see 3GPP TS 23.287 [6C])

TS 24.501 - 5.1.3 - 5GMM sublayer states: The UE shall be in one of the following 5GMM sublayer states: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED, 5GMM-REGISTERED or 5GMM-CONNECTED, depending on the progress of mobility management procedures.
TS 24.501 - 5.2.2.2 - UE behaviour in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state: The UE shall select a suitable cell and attempt registration when entering coverage or when triggered by upper layers.
TS 24.501 - 5.2.2.3 - UE behaviour in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state: If no suitable cell is available, the UE shall enter the substate NO-CELL-AVAILABLE.
TS 24.501 - 5.3.2 - Registration management: The UE shall store the registration parameters provided by the network upon successful registration.
TS 24.501 - 5.3.4 - Registration areas: The UE shall store the registration area information received in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.
TS 24.501 - 5.3.7 - Handling of the periodic registration update timer: The UE shall start timer T3512 upon successful registration.
TS 24.501 - 5.3.9 - Handling of NAS level mobility management congestion control: The UE may defer mobility management procedures when congestion control is indicated.
TS 24.501 - 5.3.13 - Lists of 5GS forbidden tracking areas: The UE shall store and update the list of forbidden tracking areas for the current PLMN.
TS 24.501 - 5.3.14 - List of equivalent PLMNs: The UE shall store the list of equivalent PLMNs provided by the network.
TS 24.501 - 5.3.16 - Extended DRX cycle: The UE may apply an extended DRX cycle as indicated by the network to reduce power consumption.
TS 24.501 - 5.4.1.1 - Authentication procedure: The UE shall initiate the authentication procedure upon receiving an AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.
TS 24.501 - 5.4.2.1 - NAS security mode control: The UE shall apply the negotiated NAS security algorithms after successful security mode control.
TS 24.501 - 5.4.3.1 - Identification procedure: The UE shall provide the requested identification parameters according to the identification type indicated.
TS 24.501 - 5.4.6 - 5GMM status procedure: The UE shall send a STATUS message to indicate protocol errors when required.
TS 24.501 - 5.5.1.1 - Initial registration: The UE shall initiate the initial registration procedure when powered on or when entering a new tracking area.
TS 24.501 - 5.5.1.2 - Registration update: The UE shall perform mobility or periodic registration update as required.
TS 24.501 - 5.5.2.1 - Deregistration general: The UE may initiate deregistration when upper layers request service termination.
TS 24.501 - 5.6.1.1 - Service request procedure: The UE shall initiate the service request procedure to establish NAS signalling connection when required.
TS 24.501 - 5.6.1.5 - Service request procedure not accepted by the network: The UE shall follow the backoff and retry behaviour as specified when service request is rejected.
TS 24.501 - 5.6.2 - Paging procedure: The UE shall respond to paging by initiating the service request procedure when appropriate.
TS 24.501 - 5.6.3 - Notification procedure: The UE shall process the notification message as specified.
TS 24.501 - 7.2 - Message too short or too long: The UE shall discard messages that are too short or too long according to protocol rules.
TS 24.501 - 7.4 - Unknown or unforeseen message type: The UE shall handle unknown message types according to error handling procedures.
TS 24.501 - 7.6 - Unknown and unforeseen information elements: The UE shall ignore or handle unknown information elements as specified without aborting the procedure.
